findings.claim: LINE_IN_VOL at0x08241570 parses up/down/level as selectors0/1/2, followed by two decimal arguments. It queues a three-byte payload through event0x27. It does not directly write a gain RAM field.
AT parser0x08237FE0 maps line_in,in/out to event0x26 and usb_in,in/out to event0x28, with value1/0. These are manual controls, not a proven source-priority rule.
AT+USBAUDIO handler0x08246928 maps ON/OFF to0x0824690C, which queues event0x63. OUT_CTRL,ON/OFF uses0x08245C28 and eventgroup3/action0x20/subevent2.
USB event consumer0x08245FFC initializes three common route records. It uses source IDs2,3,4 and keeps their handles at0x042479A8,0x042479AC,0x042479B0.

USB eventgroup0x20 changes one of three active-stream bytes. If the application USB flag is set, it queues start or stop for that stream. Event0x63 changes that flag and applies start or stop to each active stream.

The common registration routine accepts IDs0..5 and stores0x44-byte records at0x042479B8. Five direct registration calls initialize IDs0..4. No direct registration for ID5 was found in the scanned MCU range.
findings.status: static-confirmed calls; absence limited to direct BL scan

findings.claim: The USB records share the common manager with the two aux records. Their stream activity and flags therefore matter independently of jack detection.
The source-mode callback starts at0x082452CC, before a PUSH instruction. Starting at0x082452CE loses the preceding comparison and creates false incoming-condition flags.
findings.rejected_artifact: The first function in usb-events.c is a rejected mid-function export. Do not use it. The second function starts correctly at0x08245FFC.

limits: No live RAM field was read by this agent.
No source-priority order was established for AUX, USB-C, dongle, and Bluetooth.
The USB additional gate must not be called a mute flag without further evidence.
Cached volume values do not prove that a backend accepted gain or that audio reaches the drivers.
Manager exports overlap work the root later reported. Root manager analysis is authoritative for live interpretation.
The decoded image includes several processor regions. The selected MCU mapping is not a complete map of the package.
